import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

SRC = "/root/workspace/home/home/Pictures/IMG_6198.jpg"
OUT = "/root/workspace/guardianship_shelf_marked.png"

im = Image.open(SRC).convert("RGB")
W, H = im.size
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(im, "RGBA")


def font(sz):
    for p in ("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
              "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, sz)
    return ImageFont.load_default()


RED = (214, 40, 40, 255)
GREEN = (0, 150, 60, 255)
GREY = (110, 110, 110, 255)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (17, 17, 17, 255)

f_tag = font(70)
f_lbl = font(58)
f_small = font(46)


def box(x0, y0, x1, y1, color, w=14):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0, x1, y1], outline=color, width=w)


def tag(x, y, text, color):
    tb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f_tag)
    tw, th = tb[2] - tb[0], tb[3] - tb[1]
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + tw + 34, y + th + 26], fill=color)
    draw.text((x + 17, y + 8), text, font=f_tag, fill=WHITE)


guard = [(70, 560, 955, 1545), (1025, 560, 1915, 1545),
         (1985, 560, 2870, 1545), (2915, 560, 3840, 1545)]
for i, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in enumerate(guard):
    box(x0, y0, x1, y1, RED)
    tag(x0 + 12, y0 + 12, str(i + 1), RED)

draw.text((2930, 470), "OPEN - 15 left", font=f_lbl, fill=RED)

other = [(374, 1728, 1238, 2606), (1426, 1728, 2506, 2606), (2607, 1728, 3701, 2606)]
for (x0, y0, x1, y1) in other:
    box(x0, y0, x1, y1, GREY, 10)
draw.text((374, 1648), "BFL-1015 / BFL-1000 - not guardianship, not counted", font=f_small, fill=GREY)

panel_h = 470
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, panel_h], fill=(255, 255, 255, 232))
draw.rectangle([0, panel_h - 8, W, panel_h], fill=RED)
draw.text((60, 40), "PALMETTO RESOURCE FAIR - GUARDIANSHIP TABLE (BFL-1005)",
          font=f_lbl, fill=BLACK)
line2 = "Target 180   |   On shelf 135 (3 x 40 + open box 15)   |   -80 pulled for courthouse 10/6"
draw.text((60, 150), line2, font=f_small, fill=BLACK)
draw.text((60, 250), "AVAILABLE FOR FAIR TABLE: 55", font=f_lbl, fill=GREEN)
draw.text((1500, 250), "SHORT: 125", font=f_lbl, fill=RED)
draw.text((60, 360), "Red = BFL-1005 guardianship (fair stock).  Grey = other SKUs, excluded.",
          font=f_small, fill=GREY)

im.save(OUT)
print(im.size[0], im.size[1], OUT)
